oliver_docs: FYI I opened PR to consolidate examples for structured-output and add a tiny migration appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3567 :wave:
maya_engineering: i'll update the Java and Python SDK snippets to use structured_output with a compact schema. planning to show required vs optional fields and a small enum.
rahul_frontend: i'll draft a short React example that shows handling validation_errors and falling back to raw text. keep it small for the quickstart card.
emily_qa: please include one explicit failing-case snippet so I can run it through the eval harness. also add a note about maxProperties for streaming.
deploy-bot: markdown-lint queued for PR 3567 - running code-style + linkcheck.
oliver_docs: suggested schema for examples: {"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string"},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","med","high"]}},"required":["task"]}
maya_engineering: nice. python snippet draft:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
res = c.generate(model='rwd-2-small', structured_output={'schema': schema}, prompt='Extract task and priority')
print(res.structured_output)
```
rahul_frontend: react snippet:
```js
const res = await client.generate({...})
if (res.validation_errors) showFallback(res.text)
else render(res.structured_output)
```
emily_qa: running evals now. will report back in ~90m.
oliver_docs: timeline: aim to merge today then publish changelog. ok to squash.
maya_engineering: fine to squash. will push shortly.
deploy-bot: lint passed for PR 3567 - linkcheck ok.
emily_qa: update: happy path passes; failing-case returns validation_errors shape {errors:[{path,message}]}. approving.
